title: AIVA
summary: AIVA is an electronic composer trained on a large corpus of classical works by Bach, Beethoven, and Mozart. It detects musical regularities to generate original pieces. Since 2019, its Music Engine product creates short compositions across multiple styles. AIVA was the first virtual composer recognized by SACEM and has released studio albums performed by orchestras.

mechanisms.title: Pattern detection in training data
mechanisms.explanation: AIVA analyzes a large collection of existing classical music to identify regularities and structural patterns, which it uses as a basis for original composition.

mechanisms.title: Deep and reinforcement learning architectures
mechanisms.explanation: The algorithm underlying AIVA is based on deep learning and reinforcement learning architectures, enabling it to compose music autonomously after training.
